text: Yesterday, I went shopping at the market near my house. I wanted to buy some fruit and a gift for my sister's birthday. At the market, many shops sell fresh food. I asked about the price of some apples, and they were cheap, so I bought a bag of apples. Then I saw a beautiful scarf, but it was too expensive. I only had a little money in my wallet, so I couldn't buy it. I paid for the apples in cash, with coins from my pocket. The customer next to me used a discount card, so she got a lower price. I really needed a new bag too, but I didn't want to spend too much money that day. At another shop, I found a small, cheap gift for my sister. It didn't cost much, but she will love it. I think it is important to think carefully before you buy something, so you don't spend all your money too fast.
